title: TDM-READY: Technical Debt Management Adoption Readiness Checklist

creators.name: Cavalcante, Iury
creators.affiliation: Universidade Federal do Estado do Rio de Janeiro (UNIRIO)

description:
TDM-READY is a diagnostic instrument that assesses organizational readiness for adopting Technical Debt Management (TDM), that is, whether an organization meets the conditions the adoption requires. It does not measure existing technical debt, nor does it assess the maturity of a process already in operation. Its object is the set of conditions that precede adoption — those whose absence tends to make TDM initiatives fail before producing any result.

The instrument comprises 21 items across three dimensions: People (9 items), Processes (9 items) and Technology (3 items). Each item states the condition being assessed, explains why it matters, indicates whether the condition concerns the organization as a whole or only the technology area, and offers supporting questions that guide the group's deliberation. The distribution of scope is uneven by design: 13 of the 21 items assess the organization and 8 assess the technology area.

Application is collective and takes between 45 and 90 minutes. It is led by a facilitator from within the organization and brings together participants covering the roles across which knowledge of the conditions is distributed. Leaving items unanswered is a legitimate outcome: being unable to assess a condition is itself a diagnostic result, and usually indicates that the condition is neither clear, visible nor governed within the organization.

The artifact is a single, self-contained HTML file. It loads no external resources and makes no network requests; responses are stored solely in the browser of the person filling it in. The instrument's content is written in Brazilian Portuguese.

TDM-READY was developed under the Design Science Research approach, as part of a master's dissertation at the Graduate Program in Informatics (PPGI) of the Federal University of the State of Rio de Janeiro (UNIRIO). Version 3 incorporates the refinements decided upon after the case study conducted in the research.

The instrument can be applied directly at https://iurycavalcante.github.io/tdm-ready/
